# TreyVisai (ត្រីវិស័យ) — Cambodia Career & Higher Education Guidance Platform

> TreyVisai (https://www.treyvisai.com) is Cambodia's premier digital platform dedicated to career exploration, higher education guidance, tuition transparency, and national scholarship discovery for high school graduates (Bac II) and university students.

## Platform Identity & Quick Facts
- **Name:** TreyVisai (Khmer: ត្រីវិស័យ, meaning "Compass" for guiding life and career paths)
- **Domain:** https://www.treyvisai.com
- **Mission:** Democratize access to educational data, eliminate career mismatches, and empower youth across all 25 provinces of Cambodia with 100% free, impartial guidance.
- **Coverage:** 127+ accredited institutions (Public Universities, Private Universities, TVET Institutes, Digital Academies, and International Schools) across all 25 Cambodian provinces and municipalities.
- **Tuition Range:** $0 (100% full government scholarships / TVET) up to $20,000+/year for select international programs.
- **Access:** 100% free, no login or account creation required.

## Key Modules & Direct URLs
- **Homepage:** https://www.treyvisai.com/
  Central portal featuring career assessment, educational realities in Cambodia, and quick navigation.
- **Schools Directory:** https://www.treyvisai.com/schools
  Search and filter 127+ Cambodian higher education institutions by province, institution type (Public, Private, TVET Institute, Digital, K-12), and career focus. Displays detailed tuition breakdown per faculty and scholarship requirements.
- **Careers Guide:** https://www.treyvisai.com/careers
  Catalog of 100+ careers in Cambodia across Technology, Healthcare, Business, Design, Trades, Education, Tourism, and Agriculture. Includes verified salary ranges ($/month), required skills, and matching Cambodian institutions.
- **Scholarships Directory:** https://www.treyvisai.com/scholarship
  Comprehensive guide to government scholarships (Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport - MoEYS), Royal Government of Cambodia 1.5 Million TVET Program (100% free with monthly stipends for IDPoor/vulnerable youth), and partner scholarships (20%–100%).
- **Bac II (High School) Score Guide:** https://www.treyvisai.com/bacii
  Grade-based guidance (Grades A, B, C, D, E) and actionable alternative pathways for students who failed or did not pass the national Bac II exam (e.g. 2-year TVET Associate Degrees leading to Bachelor's transfer).
- **Cost of Study & Living Calculator:** https://www.treyvisai.com/cost
  Interactive budgeting tool for accommodation, food, utilities, transport, and tuition across Phnom Penh and provinces.
- **Student Voices & Fact Bank:** https://www.treyvisai.com/facts
  Peer reviews, authentic student testimonials, and educational trivia for informed decision-making.

## Authoritative Data Sources
Data on TreyVisai is compiled from official announcements by:
- Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport (MoEYS - ក្រសួងអប់រំ យុវជន និងកីឡា)
- Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training (MLVT - ក្រសួងការងារ និងបណ្តុះបណ្តាលវិជ្ជាជីវៈ)
- Accreditation Committee of Cambodia (ACC)
- Direct university admission catalogs and official registrar fee schedules.
